svg.aria-label: A thin Spaarke-blue hexagonal perimeter on a deep navy field, holding a smaller solid CTA-blue hexagon precisely at its center, with a faint magenta glow along the perimeter's outer edge.
svg.title: Your legal data belongs to you — boundary as structure
svg.desc: A single confident geometric perimeter — a hexagon drawn in a thin Spaarke-blue line at roughly two-thirds the frame width — holds a smaller solid CTA-blue hexagonal form precisely at its center. A faint magenta glow halo runs along the perimeter's outer edge, suggesting a security boundary expressed as form rather than as a vault or a lock.
